name: Flynas Company
summary: Flynas Company operates airlines in Saudi Arabia and the Middle East. It operates through three segments: flynas Low-Cost Carrier; flynas Hajj and Umrah; and flynas General Aviation (NasJet) Services. The company provides crew services, maintenance of aircraft, and other ancillary services, as well as commercial scheduled flights services. It also operates as a travel agency, and tour and travel operators; and leases aircrafts. The company operates fleet of 61 aircraft. It serves individual passengers and tour groups, corporate customers, government entities, and private aircraft owners. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
